$comment: The camera's on-glass palette: the one source for firmware/p4/main/ui_palette.h. Edit here, then run npm run palette:gen. npm run palette:check fails when the header is stale. Values are sRGB hex; the panel shows them as RGB565, so the low 3 bits of red and blue and the low 2 of green are dropped.

K_GROUND.note: The ground: the shoot and photograph views, the boot field, sleep.

K_FACE.note: The face: the ground of the menu and every detail screen.

K_SHADOW.note: Darker than the ground. Today only the ROLL lamp when offline.

K_SCRIM.note: Black: the scrim over a screen and the panel going dark.

K_SURFACE.note: A window or list ground, and the pane behind a photograph.

K_ROW.note: A row you can press: one flat tone for every row of every list.

K_HAIRLINE.note: A surface that only needs to be a surface: an empty four-mark cell, a track under a bar. 1.3:1 on the face.

K_OFF.note: A neutral press, a toggle that is off, an idle four-mark cell, a tile still loading.

K_RULE.note: The hairline between two facts in a table, and under a header.

K_EDGE.note: The edge of a thing you can press: 3.4:1 on the face, 3.2:1 on a window (WCAG 1.4.11 asks 3:1).

K_INK.note: The light ink: every word on the dark grounds.

K_INK_QUIET.note: The quiet ink: 5.2:1 on the face, 4.8:1 on a window, 5.4:1 on the ground. The small face needs 4.5.

K_ACCENT.note: The accent: selection, a press, the capture spark, the star, the gauges.

K_ACCENT_INK.note: The dark ink set on the accent and on the card.

K_CARD.note: The SHOOT card, the screen titles and the wordmark.

K_LIVE.note: Live and fine: a camera that answered, SENT, the menu labels, the toast plate.

K_TOAST_INK.note: The toast's ink, dark on the live plate, so a remark never reads as a selection.

K_FAULT.note: Red as a mark or a fill: a lost camera, a destructive press, the lens hint.

K_FAULT_INK.note: Red as type on the dark grounds: 5.9:1 on a window, where K_FAULT measures 3.5.

K_SELECT.note: A selected or pressed control's fill.

K_SELECT_INK.note: The ink on K_SELECT, and the focus ring.

K_TITLE.note: A screen's or a dialog's title, set on the ground.

K_MARK.note: The wordmark at boot and at sleep.

K_MENU_ROW.note: The menu's five rows under the SHOOT card, at rest, each a step darker than the one above. The floor stops clear of the ground so the bottom row is still a card.

K_BF_WARM.note: The boot field's four inks per look, light to dark. A look picks its row by hashing its id.

rows.note: the standard look: amber and green, the reference's own warm pair
a warm look: the product's terracotta against its card colour
a cool look: mint, which is what this interface says live in
a neutral look, for a look that is not grading much at all

K_BF_COLD.note: Cold: the instrument before it knows what it is shooting. The field comes up in this and travels to the look's own inks as the cameras answer.
